title: Development and validation of a motivation scale for deep vein thrombosis prophylaxis in postdischarge hip and knee arthroplasty patients
core_idea: Develop a protection-motivation-theory-based instrument to measure patients' motivation for post-discharge DVT prophylaxis after hip or knee arthroplasty by generating items through literature review, interviews, and expert consultation, then evaluating its psychometric properties in a cross-sectional survey.
tldr: This study aimed to create and psychometrically evaluate a theory-grounded scale that assesses cognitive drivers of motivation for deep vein thrombosis prophylaxis among patients after hip or knee arthroplasty, using mixed methods for item generation and quantitative testing for validity and reliability.
